My best placements this year didn't start with a req.

They started with a conversation about workforce strategy. What the team needs to look like in 12 months. Which roles are actually load-bearing. What the last hire got wrong and why.

By the time the role was defined, I had helped define it. That's a different search entirely. I'm not interpreting someone else's job description; I'm working from a role we built together.

🚨 Hiring RANT alert.

I have personally interviewed every single person who has ever worked with me. Some of them twice.

I've hired through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, AngelList, IIMJobs and agencies. I've made bad hires. I've written roles that weren't fully baked, because we're still growing and I need people who go beyond what's on paper.
